item.title: Ariana Grande Drops ‘American Horror Story’ Season 13 Amid Touring Schedule
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we're talking about Ariana Grande and her exit from American Horror Story's 13th season. Let's dive in."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "Ariana Grande was initially announced as part of the cast for American Horror Story's 13th season, subtitled 13, back in October 2025. This would have marked her first appearance on the Ryan Murphy anthology series and a reunion with the producer, who she worked with on Scream Queens in 2015."
[Music fades slightly]
Host: "However, due to a scheduling conflict with her ongoing Eternal Sunshine Tour, Grande will no longer be appearing in the season. The tour, which kicked off in June, has taken priority, and a recent change to the show's production schedule created a direct conflict with her tour dates."
[Music transitions back in]
Host: "The season will still feature a returning ensemble, including Sarah Paulson, Evan Peters, and Jessica Lange, and is set to premiere on September 24th on FX. Meanwhile, Grande's Eternal Sunshine Tour continues, supporting her seventh studio album, which debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 and spawned two Billboard Hot 100 number one singles."
[Music fades out]
Host: "And don't worry, Grande's film work isn't going anywhere. She's set to appear in the Meet the Parents sequel, Focker-In-Law, due out this fall. We'll keep you updated on her latest projects. That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard."
[Outro music plays]
